old: \uD83D\uDCA1 PRO TIP: With a 10%+ rating you may qualify for VR&E \u2014 evaluate it BEFORE the GI Bill. It can cover what the GI Bill does and more, without burning your 36 GI Bill months. GI Bill MHA pays at the E-5-with-dependents BAH rate for your school's ZIP (tax-free; varies widely).
new: If a service-connected condition affects work, ask a VA Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor whether VR&E fits your employment goal. Compare your benefit options before choosing training. GI Bill housing payments depend on eligibility, duty status, training or enrollment, and location.
